shortDescription: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva will be re-elected, the CEO of pollster AtlasIntel, Andrei Roman, told Reuters on Sunday, citing the ongoing vote count in the presidential runoff vote against Senator Flavio Bolsonaro.
